design_rationale:
WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. The caller asks for one man to be taken off a cruise booking. She never mentions money and never asks what it costs. Producing the terminal state forces the agent to (a) find the operations desk's approved change request, without which the party may not be altered at all, (b) read in the re-pricing policy that the price for the party actually travelling is fixed only after the ledger carries an amendment charge posted since the operations desk approved the change, (c) see that the only amendment charge standing was posted before that approval and answers an earlier change, (d) work that charge out from a name-change ladder, a head-count method, a repeat-amendment loading and a club waiver, (e) withhold it, and only then (f) re-price the package across five more rules and hand the booking change to the traveller to make herself. The tools are never in doubt; the difficulty is entirely in discovering the second problem and in arithmetic over a ten-line ledger, a change-request record, a club card and a club benefit ledger.

SCOPE LEDGER (Principle C). Task 0 occupied bundle_ext_operator_surcharge_pricing and bundle_ext_balance_settlement with price_package_surcharge_8a2d0e07 and settle_package_balance_32304520 - the operator-surcharge and payment-schedule cores. This task claims the two that were reserved for it: bundle_ext_party_amendment_charge (withhold_amendment_charge_5474525c) and bundle_ext_places_given_up (confirm_places_given_up_9aa48f75) - the penalty/amendment core and the party re-pricing core. The two scopes are disjoint in policies and in tools, and together they cover all four extended policies of the difficulty. Nothing is reserved for a later task: M is 2 and this is the last. Base policies still untouched by either task - bundle_credit, bundle_refund_settlement, bundle_travel_period, bundle_agg_multi_holding - remain available to any later difficulty work and are not needed here.

STEP 0 DRAW (verbatim output of scripts/draw_counts.py env/online_travel_agency/tasks/vacation_packages_desk --tasks 2):
{"task": 0, "key": "online_travel_agency/vacation_packages_desk/0", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 5]}
{"task": 1, "key": "online_travel_agency/vacation_packages_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 4]}
Task 1 therefore has exactly one prerequisite problem and two computations carrying 5 and 4 factors. bundle_ext_places_given_up took the 5 (per_place_price_basis, single_occupancy_adjustment, withheld_charge_carry, club_repricing_rate, price_guarantee_repricing); bundle_ext_party_amendment_charge took the 4 (change_request_admin_rate, travellers_charged_basis, repeat_amendment_loading, club_change_fee_waiver).

PROBLEM-TREE CARD (Principle H). Root problem: bundle_ext_places_given_up - what the caller's surface request points at ("she needs him taken off the booking and the booking left standing for the rest of them"). One prerequisite problem: bundle_ext_party_amendment_charge.
Edge bundle_ext_places_given_up <- bundle_ext_party_amendment_charge. kind: value_input. gate: withheld_charges, a real compute binding of the blocked policy. form: state. Prerequisite sentence, verbatim in the blocked policy's own rule: "The price the package carries for the party actually travelling is fixed only after the ledger carries an amendment charge posted since the operations desk approved the change to the travelling party." Four-point test: (1) "only after" joins this policy's own result - the price the package carries for the party actually travelling - to what it waits on; (2) the XX side is a record-visible state, a kind of entry standing on the package ledger, and names no action, no performer and no tool; (3) it carries no tool name, no policy id, no snake_case token and no row id; (4) "only after" is the hard strength the edge has, and the scope is an amendment charge posted since the approval, exactly what condition names; the sentence was reworded in round 2 so that a reader separates the state it waits on from a charge already standing for an earlier change by reading the ledger against the approval date the records themselves carry, rather than by date work the rule never asks for. The state form was available and is used, so no fallback_reason. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: withhold_amendment_charge_5474525c is the only tool in task_tools.py that creates a line of charge_category amendment_fee, and bundle_ext_party_amendment_charge is the only policy whose result is an amendment charge withheld. Derivation a reader performs: the sentence says an amendment charge answering this change must stand; the ledger lookup shows one amendment charge, posted 2026-08-20, tied to the first deposit line and predating the 2026-09-11 approval, so nothing answers this change; the amendment-charge policy's own rule says what such a charge is and how it is worked out; therefore the one action that brings the state about is to withhold it - exactly one reading. Condition: "The package ledger carries an amendment charge answering the change to the travelling party." resolved_by: withhold_amendment_charge_5474525c (owner=agent). The root's write is owner=user (confirm_places_given_up_9aa48f75), so the tree carries the customer's own write.
Why the prerequisite is false at the opening: recorded row by row in prerequisite_closure.edges[0].unresolved_at_frozen_time.evidence - the approval decided_at 2026-09-11, the only amendment line posted 2026-08-20 and tied to a deposit line, and the one later ledger line being an operator notice of 2026-08-30 that carries no charge.
Topological order: [bundle_ext_party_amendment_charge, bundle_ext_places_given_up], which is the gold write order (actions 9 then 11). No parallel edges, so order_uniqueness is trivial and recorded as such.
Deletion sensitivity (Step 5 run): skipping action 9 and replaying everything else leaves withheld_charges at 260.00 instead of 556.80, carried_charges at 260.00 instead of 556.80, and revised_package_price_usd at 28547.71 instead of 28844.51 - plus the missing amendment line in the terminal ledger. The edge bears weight.
The tool layer blocks nothing: withhold_amendment_charge_5474525c is one ctx.make_id and one ctx.create; confirm_places_given_up_9aa48f75 is one ctx.update with the arguments given. Neither reads a row, tests a status or returns an error, so the re-pricing tool is fully callable while the charge is still unwithheld and only the terminal hash records the difference.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Write 1, subject bundle_penalty_charge. The only base policy whose subject includes that event is bundle_cancellation; its single eligibility, places_given_up_stated, applies to bundle_cancel and bundle_predeposit_cancel and not to bundle_penalty_charge, so nothing is subject-scoped here and the policy enters as policy_scope with the product and status as evidence. Deliberately, no task tool in this difficulty takes bundle_cancel or bundle_predeposit_cancel as its subject: that gate is a caller_fact gate whose correlation key is the internal package reference, and a caller cannot state an internal reference, so a write on that subject could never be evidenced honestly. Write 2, subject bundle_party_amend. The only governing base policy is bundle_amendment, whose change_request_approved gate (kind authorization, authority system_record, timing pre_action, correlation key bundle_change_requests.bundle_request_id bound to the tool's bundle_request_id) requires an approved change request on file: request OPS-PARTY-2026-7731 was submitted 2026-09-09 and approved 2026-09-11, before frozen time 2026-09-16, and its bundle_package_id is this package. Satisfied. Neither write has a time eligibility, so temporal_feasibility is empty, which is exactly what the contract requires when there is no time gate. Every other clause of bundle_amendment is inherited unchanged: the name-change deadline is respected (the change falls 145 days before departure, far inside the product's 35 days), the package is not being date-changed, and the balance due date of 2026-11-10 has not passed, so the clause pricing a late amendment as a cancellation and rebooking does not bite.

OVERWRITE. Both policies declare their overrides clause by clause; the earlier claim that base offered no competing figure was false and is withdrawn. bundle_ext_party_amendment_charge declares four. Against bundle_amendment it retires "A member of the party may be replaced only up to the product's name-change deadline before departure, against the product's name-change charge per traveller replaced.": base charges that rate per traveller replaced and permits no replacement inside the deadline at all, where this policy charges the rate its own ladder fixes on the travellers charged, whether a member is replaced or a place is simply given up. On this world nobody replaces the traveller who withdraws, so base read per traveller replaced gives 5.60, or 0.00 with nobody replacing, against 296.80. Against bundle_agg_party_pricing it retires the clause "the re-pricing is charged as an amendment rather than absorbed", which a reader takes as the amendment administration charge of 65.00 and which gives 137.80 on this world; the half of that base sentence that re-prices the remaining travellers at the occupancy they are left with is not named and stands, because the re-pricing policy rests on it. Against bundle_cancellation it retires "the ladder is applied to those places alone" and "The product's administration charge is withheld per traveller on every cancellation whatever the ladder says": that policy governs the very event family this charge is booked under, and at 145 days before departure its ladder would put 30 percent of the per-place price, 2252.43, plus a 125.00 administration charge, on the place given up. The extended rule now says outright that a change to the travelling party the operations desk has approved is charged as an amendment under this rule and no other, and that no cancellation ladder is read and no cancellation penalty or cancellation administration charge is withheld. bundle_ext_places_given_up declares three. Against bundle_club_and_corporate_interaction it retires "the club tier held on the deposit date decides the package discount applied to the price" and "Where the member's tier changes between deposit and departure, the discount applied at deposit stands and is neither topped up nor clawed back.", because its club rate is decided by the tier now held and the date of its next review rather than by the tier that stood at deposit; base read strictly holds the Gold 3 percent and gives 28413.73 against 28844.51. Against bundle_agg_party_pricing it retires "the supplement and the discounts never apply to the same traveller at once", and its own rule now states that the occupancy adjustment is charged on the room or cabin left under-occupied whatever discounts the travellers remaining in it carry. Every other sentence of those base policies stands and is inherited, in particular bundle_amendment's change-request authorization, which is the gate this task's second write turns on; none of the seven superseded clauses is a gate's condition sentence, so no eligibility is retired from the precondition ledger.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The narrowest object is the single Ocean Cruise Package WLCRU61508 held by this traveller; the correlation key is bundle_packages.bundle_package_id, the first argument of both tools, and for the authorization gate the narrower bundle_change_requests.bundle_request_id. The amendment charge is written back against a named source object, the balance payment line of 29480.00, which the policy pins exclusively: "The charge is withheld against the payment line that settled the balance of the package, and against no other." Rows entering the aggregates: the three component lines (per-place price), the one prior amendment charge plus the new one (repeat loading, charges carried in), the one operator notice (re-pricing rate), the one approved change request (administration charge), and the one club benefit use (waiver). Rows excluded: the four deposit lines are payments, not components or penalties, so they enter neither the per-place price nor the carried charges; the earlier amendment charge of 2026-08-20 is counted for the loading but is not the charge that answers this change, which is the whole point of the prerequisite; and the club accrual rows are excluded from the waiver count by the benefit_code filter. The traveller holds no second package.

FACTOR CARD - bundle_ext_party_amendment_charge (4 factors, the drawn count).
1. change_request_admin_rate, parameter, decides admin_rate. Tier taken: an approved name-change request stands and the change falls more than the product's name-change deadline before departure, so the product's name-change charge per traveller is taken at the early-change share. Evidence: the approved request row and DAYS(frozen date, departure) = 145 against the product's 35. Baseline: the product's amendment administration charge - 137.80.
2. travellers_charged_basis, method, decides travellers_charged. Tier taken: a child discount line stands and the record shows a child, so the travellers charged are counted as the adults alone. Evidence: the child discount line and party_children. Baseline: adults and children counted together - 442.40. It is a method factor because it changes how the head count is taken, not which number is multiplied by it.
3. repeat_amendment_loading, parameter, decides history_rate. Tier taken: exactly one amendment or name-change charge already stands and the record is confirmed. Evidence: the 2026-08-20 amendment line and the package status. Baseline: 1.0 - 280.00.
4. club_change_fee_waiver, parameter, decides waiver_credit, cross-difficulty club. Tier taken: the gold tier waives one change fee a membership year and the ledger shows none used inside twelve months. Evidence: the club membership row and the waived_change_fee benefit use of 2025-06-18. Baseline: nil credited back - 436.80.
Whole-baseline fall-back: 260.00, recorded and different from gold. Near miss: the 2025-06-18 waiver is a real use of the benefit, fourteen months back; a reader who counts it without checking the window puts the customer on the second tier and drops the credit entirely.

FACTOR CARD - bundle_ext_places_given_up (5 factors, the drawn count).
1. per_place_price_basis, method, decides per_place_price. Tier taken: component lines stand and a child travels, so the quoted price is taken together with their signed total and divided by the four shown. Evidence: the three component lines. Baseline: the quoted price over four - 30208.01.
2. single_occupancy_adjustment, parameter, decides occupancy_adjustment. Tier taken: two cabins, each counted as holding two travellers, against three retained places leave a traveller alone, and departure has not passed. The traveller left alone is the second adult, not a discounted one: the third-adult discount line sits in cabin 2 beside him and the child discount line sits in cabin 1 with the lead traveller, so the place that falls vacant is beside a traveller who carries no discount of his own. Evidence: rooms_or_cabins, the party fields, the room sequence on the two discount lines and DAYS to departure. Baseline: nil - 23186.96.
3. withheld_charge_carry, parameter, decides carried_charges. Tier taken: penalty charges stand and the record is confirmed, so they are carried in full. Evidence: the signed total of the penalty lines, which is exactly the binding the prerequisite edge names. Baseline: nothing carried - 28287.71.
4. club_repricing_rate, parameter, decides club_rate, cross-difficulty club. Tier taken: the gold tier carries a package discount and its next review falls on or before departure, so the discount is taken at the review-pending share. Evidence: the club membership's variant_name and tier_review_date against the departure date. Baseline: 1.0 - 29275.28.
5. price_guarantee_repricing, parameter, decides repricing_rate. Tier taken: the price-guarantee term ran out 106 days after the deposit and an operator notice stands. Evidence: deposit_taken_at, frozen time and the notice line. Baseline: 1.0 - 28289.84.
Whole-baseline fall-back: 23610.00, recorded and different from gold. Near miss: the operator notice carries 0.00 and concerns a shore excursion, so a reader who treats it as a money line pulls it into the component total; and the club tier_review_date of 2027-01-31 sits eight days before departure, so a reader who compares it with frozen time rather than with the departure date lands on the wrong club tier. No factor's tier is read off a stamp; the package's amount_paid_usd of 30292.40 is the only cached quantity, it agrees with the ledger at the opening, and no rule reads it.

WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS. The customer row anchors identity and supplies the two credentials the verification tool needs. The package row fixes the product, the party, the cabins, the quoted price, the status and both dates. The four deposit lines and the balance payment establish that the package is fully paid and confirmed and give the amendment charge the one line it may be withheld against. The three component lines decide the per-place price; remove the port-charges line and the per-place price moves by 189.00 and the revised price by more than 600. The 2026-08-20 amendment charge decides the repeat-amendment loading and is half of the charges carried in. The operator notice decides the re-pricing rate. The approved change request is both the base eligibility and the first tier of the administration charge. The club membership carries the tier, the waiver allowance and the review date three factors read; the waived_change_fee benefit use is the near miss for the waiver window, and the two accrual rows are what a club ledger of a long-standing member actually looks like. The care policy is the cover the product requires before a package may stand confirmed, which is why the status the carry factor reads is legitimate. Replay reports closure 18 of 18 rows: nothing is seeded that no read reaches.

PERSONA DESIGN. Marisol is the opposite of task 0's caller in tempo and manner: clipped, apologetic, working through a lunch break, precise when asked a direct question and frank when she cannot answer. Her information is laid out as a person would lay it out - the situation and the request, then the locating details with an explicit cannot-answer branch for the booking reference, then the things she only says when asked (who is left, that nobody replaces him, the club card she cannot explain, the insurance she has not touched, that nothing about the sailing has changed), then her boundary on who does what and her two passive reactions. Everything she volunteers is supported by the seed: the four travellers, the two cabins, the February sailing, the request she put in through the website, the gold card and the cover bought with the cruise. She never mentions a charge, a fee or anything owed, and she never asks what the change will cost, so she cannot steer the agent to the prerequisite. She states no figure, so she cannot telegraph 296.80 or 28844.51; if the agent writes the wrong number she closes exactly the same way. Her last reaction answers the last gold action - the booking change she makes herself - and asks for nothing beyond it.

REACHABILITY IN ONE CONVERSATION. She gives name and mobile -> find_customers; she offers date of birth and the card postal code -> verify_traveller_identity; the agent reads the package, its ledger, the change requests, the club membership, the club ledger and the protection policy, all synchronous share reads; the agent works the amendment charge out and withholds it; the agent works the revised price out, unlocks the booking tool, hands it over and she runs it. Every question a real agent must ask has a written answer - who is left, whether anyone replaces him, the cabins, the club card, the insurance - and the one she cannot answer, the booking reference, has a definite branch (she can ring back this evening, but would rather it were done now). Nothing waits on a review, a payment clearing, a delivery or a future date: the change request was already decided before the call, and both writes land under the single frozen_time 2026-09-16 14:05:00 America/Chicago.

TWO-WAY EQUIVALENCE (rule <-> compute). Forward: every world-reading or choosing binding of both policies carries a verbatim quotation in compute_basis - approved_name_change_requests, days_to_departure and admin_rate to the name-change sentences; child_lines, third_adult_lines and travellers_charged to the head-count sentences; prior_amendment_lines, prior_name_change_lines and history_rate to the loading sentences; club_waivers_granted, club_waivers_used_12m and waiver_credit to the waiver sentences; and on the re-pricing side component_total, component_lines, per_place_price, places_retained, days_to_departure, occupancy_adjustment, withheld_charges, carried_charges, club_package_pct, review_lead_days, club_rate, days_since_deposit, notice_lines, repricing_rate and result each to their own sentence. Reverse sweep: "in the last twelve months" appears as within_months=12; "standing active" as status='active'; "counted in whole calendar days from the day after the deposit was taken" as DAYS(deposit, now) against the product's term; "never less than nil" as MX(...,0.0); "rounded to two decimal places" and "rounded to two decimal places only at the end" as the single RND on each result. The one place where order and grouping could have been read two ways is the re-pricing assembly, and the rule writes it out in full - the places price and the occupancy adjustment added first, that sum reduced by the club rate, that result taken at the re-pricing rate, and the charges carried in added last - so the acting base of each rate and the moment of each step are pinned in prose rather than left to a word like "then". No sentence of either rule is unclaimed and no filter in either compute is unquoted.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate and verify; read the package, the ledger, the change requests, the club membership, the club ledger and the protection policy. From bundle_amendment, see that the party may be altered only against an approved change request, and find it. From the re-pricing rule, see that the price for the party actually travelling waits on the amendment charge owed for this change, and see from the ledger that the only amendment charge predates the approval. Work the charge: an approved name-change request and 145 days to departure give 175.00 at the early-change share, 140.00; a child discount line and a child on the record give three travellers charged; one prior amendment charge on a confirmed package gives a loading of 1.04; the gold tier's unused change-fee waiver credits 140.00 back; 140.00 x 3 x 1.04 - 140.00 = 296.80, withheld against the balance payment line. Then the re-pricing: the per-place price is (31480.00 - 1447.60) / 4 = 7508.10; three places retained give 22524.30; one traveller left alone in two cabins adds 7508.10 at 75 percent, 5631.075; the club rate is 0.985 because the tier review falls before departure; the re-pricing rate is 1.02 because the price guarantee has run out and a notice stands; the charges carried in are 556.80; (22524.30 + 5631.075) x 0.985 x 1.02 + 556.80 = 28844.51, which the traveller writes herself together with the two adults and one child remaining.

VERIFICATION ACTUALLY RUN. Both computations were evaluated with the gate's own evaluator (build_env / eval_compute / substitute from skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py) on their handling-time worlds - the opening world for the amendment charge, and the opening world plus that write for the re-pricing. Output: amendment charge 296.8 with per-factor baselines 137.8, 442.4, 280.0, 436.8 and whole-baseline 260.0; revised price 28844.51 with per-factor baselines 30208.01, 23186.96, 28287.71, 29275.28, 28289.84 and whole-baseline 23610.0; the prerequisite-skipped replay gives 28547.71. These are exactly the figures recorded in computations and gold. Gate runs: check_extended --task 1 EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK (4 tools); check_compute --task 1 COMPUTE OK (2 comps, 9 factors, 2 cross-difficulty, 10 history rows, 24 branches, 12 steps); check_solvability --task 1 SOLVABILITY OK; check_grounding --task 1 GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire --task 1 SCOPE OK; replay_tasks --task 1 REPLAY OK with determinism True, non-vacuous True, no errors and closure 18 of 18.

CLOSURE. policy -> tool -> computation -> gold call -> terminal state: bundle_ext_party_amendment_charge -> withhold_amendment_charge_5474525c -> computations[0].step 9, arg amendment_charge_usd -> evaluation_criteria[9] -> one amendment_fee line of 296.80 standing against the balance payment; bundle_ext_places_given_up -> confirm_places_given_up_9aa48f75 -> computations[1].step 11, arg revised_package_price_usd -> evaluation_criteria[11] -> the package record showing two adults, one child and 28844.51. charter_scope.extended_policies equals the set of computation policy ids and required_documents repeats it in order. Base automatic clauses checked against the seed: the balance is already paid so no non-payment cancellation can fire; the excursion credit is granted at departure, still months away; no voucher, payout or cancellation penalty is owed on a package nobody is cancelling; and neither tool writes a row of an event whose triggers reach another category - the package is not being confirmed, so no club points accrual arises.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. With the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this dossier masked, and working only from the two policy documents as they will be published, the two tool schemas, what the share tools return and what she actually says, the same conclusion follows: the amendment policy and the re-pricing policy between them state every ladder in full, the records decide every tier, and the re-pricing rule fixes the order of operations exclusively. The two places a second reading could have arisen were which payment line the charge is withheld against - pinned by an explicit sentence - and whether the club tier review is compared with frozen time or with departure - pinned by the ladder's own words. No second solution survives.

REVISIONS. (1) Symptom: the first design made the cancellation itself the customer's own write, which the blueprint's places_given_up_stated gate would have required to be evidenced by a caller statement of the internal package reference - something no caller can say. Root cause: choosing a subject whose base gate is a caller_fact gate keyed on an internal id. Change: the customer's own write became the party amendment, whose gate is an authorization gate on an approved change request, and no policy in this difficulty takes bundle_cancel as its subject. Re-run: SOLVABILITY OK. (2) Symptom: the amendment charge could have been withheld against any of five payment lines, giving several equally correct terminal states. Root cause: the tool contract states the format of the reference but the policy said nothing about which line. Change: a sentence was added to the amendment policy pinning it to the payment line that settled the balance, and the argument tracing now quotes it. Re-run: check_extended and check_solvability both OK, and the gold argument is now forced.(3) Round 2, findings 1-1 to 1-4 (four SOURCE-POLICY REDs, all undeclared overrides). Symptom: on this world base and extended reached different figures for both scored parameters - 137.80, 5.60 and 0.00 against 296.80 for the amendment charge, and 28413.73 and 23186.96 against 28844.51 for the revised price. Root cause: both policies declared overwrite [] while handling quantities that base sentences already govern, so a reader met two live clauses in the same published documents. Change: seven base clauses are now named, clause by clause, in the two policies' overwrite blocks, and each names the sentence of the extended rule that takes its place; two of those replacement sentences are new and say outright that a change to the travelling party approved by the operations desk is charged as an amendment under this rule and no other, that no cancellation ladder is read and no cancellation penalty or administration charge is withheld, and that the occupancy adjustment is charged on the room or cabin left under-occupied whatever discounts the travellers remaining in it carry. The OVERWRITE paragraph above was rewritten and its false assertion withdrawn. No formula moved: re-running check_compute gives 296.80 and 28844.51 unchanged. (4) Round 2, finding 1-2 also drove a world change. Symptom: the traveller the change left alone was the child, who carries the child discount, so base's "the supplement and the discounts never apply to the same traveller at once" and this policy reached different adjustments on the same records. Root cause: the two discount lines both sat in cabin 2. Change: the child discount line now sits in room_sequence 1 with the lead traveller and the third-adult discount line stays in room_sequence 2, so the traveller left alone is the undiscounted second adult and the declared override is not the only thing standing between the two readings; the persona's line about not moving a twelve-year-old in with anyone reads the same way. No binding reads room_sequence, so the figures are unchanged, confirmed by check_compute. (5) Round 2, finding 1-6 (observation on discoverability). Symptom: the prerequisite's state was separated from an amendment charge already standing for an earlier change only by date work the rule never asked for. Change: the prerequisite sentence now reads "The price the package carries for the party actually travelling is fixed only after the ledger carries an amendment charge posted since the operations desk approved the change to the travelling party.", and the edge's condition follows it; the state is now one the records answer directly, because the approval date stands on the change request. Re-run: EXTENDED OK, SOLVABILITY OK. (6) Round 2, findings 1-5, 1-7, 1-8, F-15 and F-16. The operator notice's charge_category was port_charges while the dossier called it a shore excursion; it is now excursion_component and both readings agree. The waiver row was described as fifteen months back where the charter's own month counting makes it fourteen; corrected, and either way it falls outside the twelve-month window. withheld_charge_carry was labelled method while its tiers are a multiplier on one fixed quantity; it is relabelled parameter, leaving this policy with one method and four parameter factors, inside every bound. The occupancy ladder's two-travellers-per-cabin basis, which lived only in compute, is now stated in the rule itself. The seeded earlier amendment line carried a source_entry_id pointing at a deposit line, contradicting this policy's own closing sentence; it now points at the balance payment line and is posted 2026-08-20, after that payment and still two and a half weeks before the change request, so it remains an earlier change that the prerequisite state excludes. The customer's own tool was renamed confirm_places_given_up_9aa48f75 so that no two uuid8 suffixes in this difficulty share a prefix; the rename is hash-neutral because that tool writes through ctx.update and mints no id.
user_scenario:
Marisol Quintero-Bailey is fifty-seven, a hospital pharmacy manager in Seattle, and she talks the way she works: short sentences, one thing at a time, an apology at the front of every awkward request. The family cruise in February was meant to be four of them - herself, her husband, her brother-in-law Cesar and her twelve-year-old daughter - in two cabins, and Cesar has now been told he cannot travel. She rings the Wanderlane desk in her lunch break, keeping half an eye on the ward, and says straight out that she needs him taken off the booking and the booking left standing for the rest of them.

She gives her name and the mobile she is ringing from, Marisol Quintero-Bailey on 7050962174, and mentions that she put the request in through the website a week or so ago and was told it had gone to the operations desk. If she is asked for something else on file she gives her date of birth, 1968-11-27, and the postal code on the card the cruise was paid from, 98109. She does not have the booking reference memorised and will not pretend otherwise; if that leaves the agent stuck she says she can dig the confirmation email out this evening and ring back, but she would rather it were sorted now.

Asked who is actually left, she is precise: there'd be two adults and the one child left, and the cabins stay as they are because she is not moving a twelve-year-old in with anyone. If she is asked whether Cesar is being replaced by somebody else, she says no, nobody is taking his place. If she is asked about her club card she says she has had it for years and thinks she is on gold, but adds that she could not tell anyone what that is meant to do for her. If she is asked about the travel insurance on the trip, she says it was bought with the cruise at the time and she has not touched it. If she is asked anything about the February sailing itself she says nothing has changed at her end and she is still expecting to go.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.bundle_package_id: Value: the internal reference of the February cruise package. argument_uniqueness_tracing.amendment_charge_usd: Value: 296.80. An approved name-change request stands against the package and the change falls 145 days before the 2027-02-08 departure, more than the product's 35-day name-change deadline, so the administration charge per traveller is the product's name-change charge of 175.00 taken at the early-change share published for this calculation, 140.00. The ledger carries a child discount line and the record shows one child travelling, so the travellers charged are counted as the three adults shown on the record alone. The ledger already carries exactly one amendment charge and the record stands at confirmed, so the loading is 1 increased by the first-amendment allowance, 1.04. The gold tier waives one change fee a membership year and the member's ledger shows no such waiver used in the last twelve months - the only one on file posted on 2025-06-18, fourteen months back - so the administration charge for one traveller, 140.00, is credited back. 140.00 x 3 x 1.04 = 436.80, less 140.00, is 296.80.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.currency_charged: Value: USD. Basis: every one of the ten lines already standing on this package carries currency_charged 'USD', including the four deposit lines and the balance payment; the docstring requires 'the currency the party is presented with for this charge, written as an ISO 4217 currency code, 3 uppercase letters'. Uniqueness: the package has one presentation currency on its whole ledger and the caller paid from a US card, so no other code is supported by anything reachable.

Basis: the policy states 'The charge is withheld against the payment line that settled the balance of the package, and against no other.' Uniqueness: the ledger carries exactly one line whose event family is a final payment; the four deposit lines settled the deposit rather than the balance, and no other line is a payment at all.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.revised_package_price_usd: Value: 28844.51. The ledger carries component lines and the record shows a child travelling, so the per-place price is the quoted 31480.00 together with the signed total of those lines, -629.60 - 1574.00 + 756.00 = -1447.60, divided by the four travellers shown: 30032.40 / 4 = 7508.10. One place is given up, so three places are retained and the places price is 22524.30. Two cabins are held and three travellers remain, which leaves one traveller occupying a cabin alone, and departure has not passed, so the occupancy adjustment is 7508.10 at the product's 75 percent single supplement share, 5631.075. The package ledger carries amendment charges of 260.00 and 296.80 and the record stands at confirmed, so 556.80 is carried in full. The gold tier carries a 3 percent package discount and its next tier review falls on 2027-01-31, on or before the 2027-02-08 departure, so the club rate is 1 less 3 percent taken at the review-pending share, 0.985. The product's 30-day price-guarantee term ran out 106 days after the deposit of 2026-06-02 and an operator notice stands against the package, so the re-pricing rate is 1.02. In the order the rule fixes: (22524.30 + 5631.075) x 0.985 = 27733.044375, x 1.02 = 28287.70526..., plus 556.80 = 28844.505..., rounded once at the end to 28844.51.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The amendment write at action 9 creates a penalty line of charge_category amendment_fee for 296.80 against the balance payment line, after which the ledger carries an amendment charge answering the approved change and the signed total of the penalty lines moves from 260.00 to 556.80.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree has a single edge and one topological order: the amendment charge is withheld, then the places are given up and the package re-priced. There are no parallel prerequisites to reorder. The order is not convention: the re-pricing policy's own rule states that the price for the party actually travelling is fixed only after the ledger carries the amendment charge owed for the change, and its compute carries the signed total of the penalty lines into the revised price, so re-pricing first would give 28547.71 instead of 28844.51 and leave a package record carrying the wrong price.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the amendment write and replaying everything else leaves withheld_charges at 260.00 instead of 556.80, the charges carried in at 260.00 instead of 556.80, and revised_package_price_usd at 28547.71 instead of 28844.51; the terminal ledger also loses the amendment line itself.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona never mentions an amendment charge, a fee, a penalty or anything owed for the change, and never asks what it will cost. She mentions only that she put a request in through the website a week or so ago and was told it had gone to the operations desk, which is the approved change request the base rule already requires and which the records carry - not the prerequisite problem, which is the charge that answers it. Her line about the desk sorting out whatever it has to sort out is a boundary on who acts and names nothing. Everything she contributes about the prerequisite is passive: she reacts only after the agent has already said what it has done.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: withhold_amendment_charge_5474525c is a single ctx.make_id followed by a single ctx.create; it reads nothing and tests nothing. confirm_places_given_up_9aa48f75 is a single ctx.update on the package record with the arguments it is given: no ctx.find, no branch, no status test, no reference to the ledger. It is callable and rewrites the booking faithfully while the amendment charge is still unwithheld, and the only consequence is the wrong price in the terminal state.
